safety.manage_contacts_desc: Share trip details with loved ones
safety.contacts_desc: Manage who can help you during emergencies.
safety.limit_reached: You can add up to 3 trusted contacts
safety.checkin_info: NexRide automatically checks in with you during certain trips to ensure your safety.
safety.checkin_footer: When enabled, NexRide will ask "Are you safe?" during eligible trips.

info.privacy_desc: NexRide is committed to protecting your privacy and personal information.
privacy_list: Your location is used only during active trips to provide navigation and safety features.
Contact access is requested only to allow you to choose trusted contacts.
Trusted contacts are never notified without your explicit action or consent.
NexRide does not sell, rent, or share personal data with third parties.
All user data is handled securely in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
info.account_desc: NexRide uses industry-standard security practices to protect your account.
account_list: Option to change your password at any time
Support for device-level security (PIN, Face ID, Touch ID)
Ability to log out from all active devices
Monitoring of suspicious or unauthorized activity
info.guidelines_desc: NexRide is built on trust, respect, and safety.
guidelines_list: Treat fellow passengers and drivers with respect
Harassment, abuse, or threatening behavior is not tolerated
Use Safety and Emergency features responsibly and only when needed
False misuse of emergency services may result in account suspension
Follow local laws and public safety rules during travel

safety.women_safety_banner_desc: Silent monitoring features designed to keep you safe without causing panic.
safety.guardian_desc: Silent background monitoring. We detect unexpected stops or route deviations and gently check if you're okay.
safety.delayed_desc: If you don't reach your destination on time, we'll ask for confirmation before alerting your contacts.
safety.awareness_desc: "This area is quieter at night. Stay alert and keep your phone accessible."
safety.reached_safely_desc: Sends a non-emergency update to your trusted contacts.
safety.auto_checkin_desc: Receive periodic prompts ('Are you safe?') during long trips or late-night rides.
safety.privacy_note: Women Safety features work only during active journeys and only with your permission. Your location and safety data are never shared without your action.
